verdict.rationale: Loops is an email SaaS that ships a CLI, SDKs and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out of either, whether for the CLI, the SDKs or the dashboard. Because the axis applies but no evidence supports it, the verdict is none rather than na.
